Name: Aries
Location: The Aries is found in the Dali windmill. It is behind the shaft of the windmill at the bottom floor.

Name: Taurus
Location: The Taurus is found behind the item shop in the slums of Treno.

Name: Gemini
Location: The Gemini is found by throwing ten gil into the fountain at the entrance of Treno thirteen consecutive times.

Name: Cancer
Location: The Cancer is found behind the overturned cart in the suburbs of Burmecia. The player must check the area around the cart on the left side for the coin.

Name: Leo
Location: The Leo is found in Alexandria Castle's Neptune statue room, in the corner of the right wall. The player must get there by going through the west tower's side door.

Name: Virgo
Location: The Virgo is found in the inn of the Black Mage Village, next to the chest.

Name: Libra
Location: The Libra is found next to the fountain in Madain Sari, toward the rear.

Name: Scorpio
Location: The Scorpio is found in the Cave area of Quan's Dwelling, at the bottom of the screen, near where the hot spring can be accessed to restore HP and MP.

Name: Sagittarius
Location: The Sagittarius is found in Lindblum's Business District, during its reconstruction. The player must search the corner of the dirt path on the left side of the screen.

Name: Capricorn
Location: The Capricorn is found submerged to the right of Daguerreo's entrance.

Name: Aquarius
Location: The Aquarius is found behind the right pillar in a chest at Ipsen's Castle.

Name: Pisces
Location: The Pisces is found in a chest at the Core area of the Invincible.

Name: Ophiuchus
Location: After all the other twelve are discovered and given to Queen Stella in Treno, she suspects that there may be a thirteenth Stellazzio. She will then give the player back all twelve coins to figure out the location of the thirteenth coin.
